Fit a linear model to diversity data

Source: R/modeling.R
fitDiversityModel.Rd

Fits a linear model (lm) relating a diversity metric to one or more predictors. When group_col is supplied it is included as a fixed effect (a full mixed-effects model would require the nlme dependency).

Usage

fitDiversityModel(div_df, formula, group_col = NULL)

Arguments

div_df

A data.frame containing the diversity metrics and predictor columns (e.g.\ output of as.data.frame(calcDiversity(...))).

formula

A formula or character string describing the model (e.g.\ shannon ~ timepoint).

group_col

Character scalar (optional). Column name in div_df representing a grouping variable. Added as a fixed effect if not already present in formula.

Value

A list with components:

model

The fitted lm object.

summary_df

A data.frame of coefficient estimates, standard errors, t-values, and p-values.

residuals

Numeric vector of model residuals.

Examples

df <- data.frame(
    shannon = c(1.2, 1.5, 0.8, 1.1, 1.9, 0.7),
    timepoint = c(1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3),
    group = c("A", "A", "A", "B", "B", "B")
)
res <- fitDiversityModel(df, shannon ~ timepoint)
res_grouped <- fitDiversityModel(df, shannon ~ timepoint,
    group_col = "group")
